card.name: Linking words before Idaho and Montana places
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (in, and, the, commas) just before a place name in Idaho, Montana or Wyoming. Also digits inside Mountain West addresses.

modes.label: Link word before a place
modes.description: The word 'in', 'and' or 'the' sits right before an expected Idaho or Wyoming place name.
modes.example: Forest Service, Intermountain Research Station. 86 p. Discusses fire as an ecological factor for forest habitat types occurring<< in>> central Idaho.

modes.label: List of local towns
modes.description: A comma or 'and' inside a list of northern Idaho or Montana towns.
modes.example: Hayden Lake-Avondale<<,>> Dalton Gardens, and Hayden Lake.

modes.label: Digits in regional addresses
modes.description: A digit in a zip code or year in text about this region.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward Mountain West place names such as Boise, Snake and Helena.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a town or river in Idaho, Montana or nearby states.
